note: D31. One outward move per condition, for a cause the team has named that sits outside it. Reached through this registry rather than through a chip route, because there is one move per condition and not one per chip, which is the same shape as locus_discovery_action. An outward action opens no cycle: it is surfaced to the manager and never delivered, because closure requires the team's own answers to move and an external cause will not move them.
